title: MAS-Gate: Unlocking Multi-Agent System Lifecycle via Node-Centric Quantification
abstract: arXiv:2610.17613v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) can solve complex problems beyond the reach of a single agent by decomposing tasks and coordinating complementary capabilities. Despite extensive research on MAS, existing work largely focuses on specific aspects or individual phases of their development and operation, resulting in fragmented perspectives with objectives and signals that are difficult to reconcile across these different settings. To bridge these disconnected perspectives, we conceptualize MAS development and operation as a three-phase lifecycle spanning design-time orchestration before execution, runtime intervention during execution, and post-hoc attribution after execution, and introduce MAS-Gate, a unified node-centric quantification applicable across these phases. translated_title: MAS-Gate：通过节点中心量化解锁多智能体系统的全生命周期
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）能够通过任务分解和协调互补能力，解决单个智能体无法应对的复杂问题。尽管针对MAS的研究众多，现有工作大多聚焦于其开发与运行的特定方面或个别阶段，导致视角碎片化，不同场景下的目标与信号难以相互协调。为弥合这些割裂的视角，我们将MAS的开发与运行概念化为一个三阶段生命周期，涵盖执行前的设计时编排、执行中的运行时干预以及执行后的事后归因，并提出MAS-Gate——一种可贯穿这些阶段的统一节点中心量化方法。MAS-Gate将每次执行建模为有向无环图，结合节点内效用（通过变化来估计节点的贡献）……
tldr: 提出MAS-Gate，一种统一的节点中心量化方法，将多智能体系统的开发与运行概念化为设计时编排、运行时干预和事后归因三阶段生命周期，从而打通各阶段割裂的研究视角。
en_tdlr: MAS-Gate, a unified node-centric quantification method, conceptualizes the multi-agent system lifecycle into three phases—design-time orchestration, runtime intervention, and post-hoc attribution—thereby bridging the fragmented perspectives across MAS development and operation.
